    Dordt Men, Joseph Cross from Mount Marty Claim Titles at GPAC Cross Country Championships

    (Sioux Center, Iowa) - The 2026 Great Plains Athletic Conference Men's Cross Country Championships, powered by Two West and presented by IMA, were held on Saturday, November 7, in Sioux Center, Iowa, at Dordt University.
